blog_title: How to Check T-Shirt GSM at Home — 220 GSM vs 160 GSM Fraud Exposed for Bulk Buyers
caption:
Ordered 220 GSM, got 160 instead 😬

A customer lost ₹40k on 500 pieces. Fabric was too thin for printing. We tested 3 home methods: cut & weigh (multiply by 10.76), feel test (160 = empty, 220 = solid), light test (if you see through it, it's below 180 GSM).

Save this post before your next bulk order 👇
